providers.description: Service Properties Trust (NASDAQ: SVC) is a real estate investment trust (REIT) with approximately $9.9 billion invested across two asset categories: service-focused retail net lease properties and hotels. As of March 31, 2026 SVC owned 761 net lease properties (over 13.6 million sq ft) and 93 hotels (over 21,000 guest rooms) throughout the United States. The company is externally managed by The RMR Group (NASDAQ: RMR). SVC does not operate a public developer program and exposes no public APIs, OpenAPI specifications, SDKs, or webhooks; investor-facing endpoints are limited to SEC filings, press releases, email alerts, and end-of-day stock quotes.

providers.name: YOOX NET-A-PORTER (YNAP)
providers.description: YOOX NET-A-PORTER (YNAP) is a leading digital multi-brand luxury fashion group operating the online stores NET-A-PORTER, MR PORTER, YOOX, and THE OUTNET. Following the 2025 acquisition by Mytheresa, the group operates under the parent LuxExperience B.V. (NYSE ticker "LUXE"), pairing full-price curated luxury with off-price destinations. YNAP was surfaced as a portfolio company of balderton-capital and added to the API Evangelist network. The group runs an engineering organization (YNAP Tech) and maintains public GitHub open-source tooling, but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or partner developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Cashmatic
providers.description: Cashmatic provides automated cash and card payment solutions for point‑of‑sale businesses. Their platform optimizes cash handling, reduces change‑making errors, and enhances transaction security, helping retailers streamline operations and improve customer experience.

providers.name: Floom
providers.description: Floom is a curated online marketplace for flowers and plants that connects customers with a vetted network of independent local florists, enabling same-day and next-day delivery of designer bouquets, arrangements, and gifts across the United Kingdom and United States. Rather than operating central warehouses, Floom routes each order to a nearby artisan florist, and also provides those florists with e-commerce, ordering, and fulfillment technology to run and grow their businesses online.

providers.name: Purplle
providers.description: Purplle is an Indian beauty and personal care e-commerce marketplace headquartered in Mumbai, founded in 2012 by Manish Taneja, Rahul Dash, Suyash Katyayani and Anurag Neema. The platform sells skincare, makeup, haircare, fragrance, bath and body, grooming, mom and baby and wellness products across India, carrying a catalogue of 60,000+ products from 1,000+ brands alongside its own homegrown labels — Good Vibes, DERMDOC, Alps Goodness, NY Bae, FACES CANADA, Carmesi, Salm Skin and Juicy Chemistry. Purplle became an Indian unicorn in 2022 and is backed by ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Peak XV Partners, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, JSW Ventures and Blume Ventures. It operates a consumer website and mobile app plus 100+ offline stores, and publishes editorial guidance through Purplle Magazine. Purplle is a direct-to-consumer retailer: as of this profile it publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract. It does publish an llms.txt at its web root describing its catalogue for AI agents.

providers.name: Shopzilla
providers.description: Shopzilla is a comparison-shopping brand that lets consumers search across thousands of merchants to compare products, prices, and merchant ratings. Originally launched as BizRate and later Shopzilla, Inc., the business rebranded its corporate entity to Connexity in 2014 and is today operated by Connexity, a Taboola company, alongside sibling properties such as Bizrate, Beso, and PriceGrabber. Shopzilla itself publishes no API: no Shopzilla-branded developer host resolves in DNS (developer.shopzilla.com, api.shopzilla.com and docs.shopzilla.com are all NXDOMAIN), and www.shopzilla.com sits behind an AWS CloudFront WAF that bot-challenges the root and returns HTTP 403 on every other path, including all /.well-known/ locations. The publisher/affiliate API program that was historically marketed as the Shopzilla Publisher Program is today published under the CONNEXITY brand, on Connexity-owned hosts, and is deliberately not catalogued here: the docs are titled "Connexity Monetization API", list info@connexity.com as the contact, and are served from api.cnnx.link and publisher-api.connexity.com. The legacy Catalog API host catalog.bizrate.com does still answer, but returns bare Tomcat errors and publishes no specification. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners; the 2026-08-13 enrichment pass probed 18 paths across three hosts, swept five package registries, and found no Shopzilla developer surface of any kind.

providers.name: Topo Athletic
providers.description: Topo Athletic is a performance footwear brand offering road running, trail running, hiking, and recovery shoes plus apparel and accessories (Topo Gear). Its shoes are known for a roomy toe box, secure midfoot and heel fit, low heel-to-toe drop, and the ZipFoam midsole, designed to promote natural movement and foot health. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Topo Athletic operates a direct-to-consumer e-commerce site at topoathletic.com; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation. It does publish a machine-readable /llms.txt describing its catalog and support surface.

providers.name: Tupperware Brands
providers.description: Tupperware Brands Corporation was an American multinational consumer goods company that manufactured and marketed premium kitchen storage, preparation, and serving products under the Tupperware brand, as well as related home product lines. The company distributed products to approximately 70 countries through independent sales force members. Tupperware Brands filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in September 2024 and underwent liquidation in 2025. The Tupperware brand name was subsequently acquired by Party Products LLC. No public developer API program was available during the company's operation.

providers.name: Westwing
providers.description: Westwing is Europe's number one "Beautiful Living" e-commerce company, present in more than 20 European countries. It is a premium one-stop Home & Living destination that offers design lovers a carefully curated selection of the best design brands alongside its own Westwing Collection, created by an in-house team in Munich, spanning furniture, sofas, lighting, beds, rugs, textiles, outdoor and home accessories. Westwing (Westwing Group SE) is a publicly listed company and was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of HV Capital and Point Nine. It publishes no public developer API; its primary machine-facing surface is a root-level /llms.txt policy that governs how LLMs and agents may use its catalog and editorial content.

providers.name: Cornershop by Uber
providers.description: Cornershop is an on-demand grocery and essentials delivery service founded in 2015 in Chile by Oskar Hjertonsson, Daniel Undurraga, and Juan Pablo Cuevas, simultaneously launching in Santiago, Chile and Mexico City, Mexico. The platform connects consumers with personal shoppers who pick and deliver groceries, pharmacy items, and other goods from local supermarkets, specialty stores, and big-box retailers. After a 2018 acquisition attempt by Walmart was blocked by Mexican regulators, Uber agreed in October 2019 to acquire majority ownership, completing full acquisition in July 2021 at a reported valuation north of US$3 billion — Chile's first unicorn exit. At its peak Cornershop operated in eight countries across the Americas: Chile, Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Peru, Canada, and the United States. Beginning in 2021 Uber merged the Cornershop brand into Uber Eats, migrating the grocery vertical ("Uber Eats Grocery") into its main consumer app and progressively shutting down the standalone Cornershop apps and websites. As of 2026 cornershopapp.com and cornershop.io redirect to ubereats.com, the Cornershop LLC GitHub organization (archived October 2024) has zero public repositories, and there is no public developer API, SDK, partner program, or technical documentation under the Cornershop brand — Cornershop survives only as engineering history and as the LatAm backbone of Uber Eats Grocery. Community-built unofficial Python wrappers exist on GitHub but reverse-engineer the consumer mobile app and are not sanctioned by Uber.

providers.name: Credit Agricole
providers.description: Credit Agricole is a leading French banking group offering a wide range of retail, corporate and investment banking services. It serves millions of customers through an extensive network of branches and digital channels, providing accounts, loans, payments, insurance and wealth management solutions. The group emphasizes innovation and digital transformation, supporting developers with online services and APIs across its financial ecosystem.

providers.name: Mashgin
providers.description: Mashgin builds an AI-powered, computer-vision self-checkout system that identifies multiple items simultaneously without barcodes, letting customers check out in seconds. Its touchless kiosks are deployed across 5,000+ locations including convenience stores, stadiums, arenas, universities, and healthcare facilities, and integrate with 50+ payment networks, POS systems, and loyalty programs. Mashgin does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; integrations are handled through direct partnerships and its support and knowledge-base channels. Backed by Matrix Partners, SUSA Ventures, and Y Combinator.

providers.name: Mytheresa
providers.description: Mytheresa is a German luxury fashion e‑commerce retailer offering a curated selection of designer clothing, shoes, bags and accessories for women. The platform provides a premium shopping experience with worldwide shipping, exclusive collections, and a focus on high‑end brands. Founded in 2006, MyTheresa has grown into a leading online destination for luxury fashion, combining curated editorial content with a seamless digital storefront.

providers.name: Blackshoppingchannelinc
providers.description: Black Shopping Channel, Inc. operates a comprehensive e‑commerce platform offering a wide range of consumer products including health & beauty, home care, fashion, electronics, and specialty items targeting the Black community. Founded in Florida in 2007, the company runs a TV shopping network and an online storefront, providing catalog browsing, product details, and purchasing options across multiple categories.

providers.name: Busy Ming Group
providers.description: Busy Ming Group (Hunan Mingming Busy Commercial Chain Co., Ltd. / 湖南鸣鸣很忙商业连锁股份有限公司) is a mass-market snack retail chain operator headquartered in Changsha, Hunan, China, and a consumer-sector portfolio company of HongShan (formerly Sequoia Capital China). It operates two discount snack store brands — Snacks Are Busy (零食很忙, founded 2017) and Zhao Yiming Snacks (赵一鸣零食, founded 2019) — which combined into a network of more than 21,000 retail locations, heavily concentrated in county-level cities and townships. The group publishes no public developer API; this profile captures the company's corporate, franchising, and investor-relations web presence.

providers.name: Liberty Interactive
providers.description: Liberty Interactive Corporation owned and operated a broad range of video and online commerce companies, including QVC, HSN, and zulily, before being reorganized into Qurate Retail Group in 2018. The corporation tracked separate operating units through Liberty Interactive Group and Liberty Ventures Group tracking stocks.

providers.name: Premier Investments
providers.description: Premier Investments Limited is an Australian public company limited by shares, listed on the Australian Securities Exchange (ASX) since 15 December 1987. It was established as an investment vehicle to maximise growth in capital returns to shareholders through the acquisition of controlling or strategic shareholdings in premier Australian companies, with a particular focus on retailing, importing and distributing. Its corporate site publishes investor information, financial results, annual reports, ASX announcements and board policies; no public developer API or documentation was found on it.

providers.name: Related Companies
providers.description: Related Companies is a privately held, fully integrated real estate firm founded by Stephen Ross in 1972 as an affordable-housing developer and now active across luxury residential, affordable housing, retail, office, hospitality, data centers, and city-scale mixed-use development. Related is the developer of Hudson Yards in New York City, The Grand LA, Time Warner Center (now Deutsche Bank Center), The 78 in Chicago, and operates regional platforms including Related Beal, Related Midwest, Related California, Related Ross, and Related Argent in the UK. The firm owns and manages roughly 55,000 affordable and workforce housing units and has stated it has never converted a single affordable unit to market rate. Stephen Ross also owns a majority stake in Equinox Holdings (Equinox fitness clubs, Equinox Hotels, SoulCycle, Blink Fitness) and the Miami Dolphins / Hard Rock Stadium.

providers.name: Shopkeep
providers.description: ShopKeep was a cloud-based iPad point-of-sale (POS) platform for independent retailers, restaurants, and quick-serve businesses, offering register, inventory, employee management, payments, and analytics. Founded in 2008 and backed by Canaan Partners, ShopKeep was acquired by Lightspeed Commerce in 2020 and its product and brand have since been folded into the Lightspeed Retail (S-Series) line. The marketing domain shopkeep.com now redirects to lightspeedhq.com/shopkeep, and support has migrated to shopkeep-support.lightspeedhq.com. ShopKeep never shipped a publicly documented developer API — a private "API beta" existed circa 2015 and the app backend at api.shopkeep.com remains live as a session-authenticated, undocumented internal service. No public OpenAPI, SDKs, developer portal, or API reference are published, so this profile is identity-only.

providers.name: Alltricks
providers.description: Alltricks is a French online retailer specializing in cycling, running, and outdoor / mountain-sports equipment. Founded in 2008 and headquartered near Paris in Saint-Cyr-l'Ecole (Yvelines), France, the company sells bikes and frames, components and parts, apparel, footwear, nutrition, and accessories across France and multiple European markets. Alltricks operates as a direct-to-consumer e-commerce storefront at alltricks.fr and was an early Partech portfolio company. As of this pipeline run the company publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or /.well-known/ discovery surface; this profile captures its identity and the domain-security posture of its production host.

providers.name: Avon Products
providers.description: Avon Products is a global manufacturer and marketer of beauty and related products, primarily distributed through a network of independent sales representatives. Founded in 1886 and headquartered in Northampton, UK as Avon International, it was owned by Natura &Co from 2020 until Regent acquired it in January 2026; its corporate site is avonworldwide.com. The North American business (avon.com) was separated in 2016 and has been run as a distinct company.

providers.name: Cosmart
providers.description: Cosmart is an Indonesian membership-only B2B e-commerce and procurement platform, founded in 2021 by Alvin Kumarga and Robert Tan, where members (individuals and SMEs) purchase their recurring daily and business needs in larger quantities at competitive prices. The platform lists over 100,000 products across categories including office supplies, electronics, household items, automotive parts, industrial equipment, furniture, and services, with nationwide delivery, flexible payment terms, and dedicated relationship managers for corporate clients. Backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Lightspeed India Partners. Cosmart does not publish a public developer program, API, or SDKs; this profile captures its identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Dingdong Maicai
providers.description: Dingdong Maicai (叮咚买菜), operated by Shanghai Yibai Mi Network Technology Co., Ltd., is a Chinese on-demand fresh grocery e-commerce and delivery platform. It runs a mobile-app marketplace for fresh produce, meat, seafood, prepared foods, and daily groceries, backed by a network of front-line neighborhood micro-fulfillment stations that enable fast, same-hour delivery in major Chinese cities. The company is publicly listed on the NYSE (ticker DDL) and was backed by SoftBank Vision Fund. It is a consumer-facing operation with no public developer program or open API surface; this profile is a network lead maintained by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Eaze
providers.description: Eaze is a California-based cannabis marketplace and delivery platform that connects licensed dispensaries and cannabis brands with adult consumers, offering online ordering and same-day delivery of flower, edibles, vapes, and related products across the state. Founded in 2014 and headquartered in San Francisco, Eaze operates a consumer marketplace plus a technology and logistics stack for compliant retail. Backed by 500 Global and DCM Ventures, it was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead. Eaze does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal; its api.eaze.com host is an internal, bot-protected surface.

providers.name: Ebates
providers.description: Ebates is a consumer cash-back and rebate shopping platform founded in 2000 in San Francisco that pays members a percentage of their purchases back as cash when they shop through its links at thousands of partner retailers. Rakuten acquired Ebates in 2014 and rebranded the U.S. service as Rakuten Rewards in 2019; the ebates.com domain now redirects to rakuten.com. The business is a consumer-facing rewards and affiliate-commerce brand and does not operate an independent public developer API program. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Gentle Monster
providers.description: Gentle Monster is a South Korean luxury eyewear brand founded in 2011 and operated by parent company IICOMBINED, headquartered in Seoul. The brand designs and sells avant-garde sunglasses and optical frames, and is widely recognized for its immersive, art-installation flagship stores and experiential retail spaces. Its sister brands include Tamburins (fragrance and body care) and Nudake (conceptual dessert and patisserie). Gentle Monster sells globally through flagship stores, department-store concessions, and its direct-to-consumer site at gentlemonster.com. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of IDG Capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; it is a consumer retail brand and publishes no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: H&M
providers.description: A Swedish multinational fast-fashion retailer offering affordable clothing, accessories, and home goods. Operates thousands of stores globally and is one of the world's largest fashion companies. No public developer portal or open API catalogue was located on hm.com or hmgroup.com.

providers.name: Heytea
providers.description: Heytea is a Chinese premium modern tea-beverage chain founded in 2012 in Jiangmen, Guangdong. It pioneered cheese-topped tea and fresh-fruit "new-style tea" and has grown to thousands of stores across mainland China and international markets including Singapore, the United Kingdom, Australia, Canada and the United States. Backed by investors including Hongshan (formerly Sequoia Capital China) and IDG Capital, Heytea runs its own mobile ordering app and retail loyalty program. As a consumer food-and-beverage retailer it publishes no public developer API, documentation portal, or SDKs; this profile is retained in the network as a company identity lead.

providers.name: Homary
providers.description: Homary is a direct-to-consumer home furnishings retailer that sells furniture, faucets, lighting, outdoor, kitchen, bath, storage and organization, decor and rugs sourced straight from manufacturers to shoppers' homes. The brand positions itself around "affordable luxury" home decor, operating an online storefront (homary.com) with category catalogs, deals, best sellers, a design service, and a business-to-business program. Homary was surfaced through the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners. As a consumer e-commerce brand it exposes only internal storefront endpoints (/hm-api/, /chart-api/, disallowed in robots.txt) and publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation at this time.

providers.name: Madison-reed
providers.description: Madison Reed is a female-founded and female-led direct-to-consumer hair color company offering 8-Free permanent, demi-permanent, and root touch-up hair color crafted in Italy, sold as at-home kits and delivered as professional services at 95+ Hair Color Bar locations across the United States. The company blends e-commerce retail, subscription replenishment, and in-person salon booking. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and True Ventures. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures identity and probed domain-security posture only.

providers.name: navabi
providers.description: navabi is an online retailer specializing in plus-size designer fashion for women, founded and headquartered in Aachen, Germany. As of July 2026 only the Canadian storefront (navabi.ca) is live: navabi.com now redirects to an unrelated parked domain (gitinama.site) and navabi.de returns a maintenance page, indicating the brand has largely wound down its international operations. The shop curates dresses, tops, jackets, jeans, coats, swimwear and accessories from luxury and contemporary labels such as Anna Scholz, Basler, Bogner, Lacoste, Roberto Cavalli and Zizzi, alongside styling advice, a fashion magazine and an affiliate program. navabi was surfaced as a portfolio company of Index Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. It is a consumer e-commerce brand with no public developer portal, API, well-known discovery surface, or published security program; enrichment probes captured only its web/domain security posture (navabi.ca).

providers.name: On
providers.description: On (On Holding AG) is a Swiss performance sportswear company founded in 2010, known for its CloudTec running shoes and athletic apparel. It designs and sells premium running footwear, clothing, and accessories worldwide through on.com and retail partners, and is publicly traded on the NYSE (ONON). On was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bond Capital. On does not publish a public developer API; this profile captures the company identity and its domain-security posture within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Outfittery
providers.description: Outfittery is a European personal-shopping and personalized-fashion e-commerce service that curates and ships tailored outfits to customers based on a style questionnaire and human stylist recommendations. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany, it operates across the UK, Spain, France, Germany, Switzerland, Austria, Belgium, the Netherlands and Sweden. Surfaced as a portfolio company of HV Capital and Northzone and added to the API Evangelist network. An enrichment probe found a consumer web/e-commerce presence with no public developer portal, API, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Pawdly
providers.description: Pawdly (포들리) is a South Korean pet e-commerce marketplace and mobile app operated by KCC I&C, offering pet product shopping across categories, saved/wishlist items, and pet-care service reservations, alongside pet-care tips and member benefits delivered through its app. KCC I&C operates as a payment intermediary and mail-order sales broker rather than the direct seller, with individual merchants fulfilling orders, shipping, and refunds. Pawdly was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. An enrichment pass found a consumer web/mobile marketplace with no public developer portal, API, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Phia
providers.description: Phia is a personal shopping assistant that helps consumers build their closet and find the best prices instantly across the web. Co-founded by Phoebe Gates and Sophia Kianni, the product spans a mobile app and a browser extension that compares prices for a given item across new and resale marketplaces, tracking more than 700 fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands. The public phia.com site is a consumer storefront (a brand directory plus editorial style edits) and exposes no developer API, documentation, or programmatic surface. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of GGV Capital and enriched from live probes of the public site.

providers.name: Philz Coffee
providers.description: Philz Coffee is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of cowboy-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: consumer. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Pop Mart
providers.description: Pop Mart International Group is a Chinese pop-culture and designer-toy company best known for its blind-box collectibles and character IP such as Labubu (The Monsters), Molly, Skullpanda and Dimoo. Headquartered in Beijing and listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, it operates retail stores, robot-shop vending machines, and a consumer e-commerce presence across China and international markets. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Hongshan (HongShan/Sequoia China). Consumer sector; no public developer API surface was found during enrichment (no developer portal, /.well-known documents, or llms.txt).

providers.name: PVH
providers.description: PVH Corp, formerly known as the Phillips-Van Heusen Corporation, is an American clothing company headquartered in Manhattan, New York City and listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker PVH. Founded in 1881, PVH today operates two iconic owned global brands — Calvin Klein and Tommy Hilfiger — along with licensed brands including Kenneth Cole New York and Michael Kors. PVH divested its Heritage Brands wholesale business (Van Heusen, Arrow, Izod, Geoffrey Beene) to Authentic Brands Group in August 2021, refocusing the company on its two flagship designer lifestyle brands. PVH does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal at the corporate level; technology and commerce integrations are handled brand-by-brand and through closed wholesale, licensing, and retail technology partnerships.

providers.name: Rasyonet
providers.description: Rasyonet is a Turkish fintech company providing integrated financial software solutions and capital markets data platforms for institutional clients, asset managers, and financial analysts. Founded in 2000 and headquartered at ITU ARI Teknopark in Istanbul, Rasyonet offers tools for analyzing global equity markets, economic indicators, mutual and pension funds, fixed-income securities, portfolio analytics, and automated financial reporting. Their flagship EquityRT platform delivers equity research, company valuation, and peer benchmarking capabilities via desktop and Excel integration. No public developer API or machine-readable specification has been documented at this time.

providers.name: RetailMeNot *
providers.description: RetailMeNot is a consumer savings destination that aggregates coupons, promo codes, cash-back offers, and deals from thousands of retailers and brands, helping shoppers in the United States save money when they buy online and in-store. It operates a website, mobile apps, and browser extensions that surface verified discount codes and cash-back at checkout, and it monetizes through retailer affiliate relationships rather than a self-serve developer platform. As of this profile RetailMeNot publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface; probing found no reachable developer portal or well-known discovery documents, and partner activity is handled through whitelabel affiliate infrastructure.

providers.name: ShoeDazzle
providers.description: ShoeDazzle is a California-based online fashion subscription retailer offering curated shoes, handbags, and accessories through a VIP membership model. Founded in March 2009 (early backers included Andreessen Horowitz and Lightspeed Venture Partners), it was acquired by JustFab in August 2013 and is now operated as a brand of TechStyle Fashion Group alongside Fabletics, JustFab, FabKids, and Savage X Fenty. ShoeDazzle is a direct-to-consumer e-commerce brand; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API documentation.

providers.name: Stailer
providers.description: Stailer (ステイラー) is a retail-commerce platform built by 10X, Inc. (株式会社10X) that lets Japanese supermarket, drugstore, and other retail chains vertically launch and operate their own branded e-commerce and online-grocery services. It provides the consumer storefront apps, order management, in-store picking and fulfillment, and delivery operations that let established brick-and-mortar retailers stand up online shopping quickly. Stailer is a B2B SaaS offering sold through direct enterprise engagement; as of this enrichment pass it exposes no public developer API, documentation portal, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: StyleSage
providers.description: StyleSage was a fashion and retail market-intelligence startup (Techstars-backed) that applied computer vision and data science to track apparel pricing, assortment, discounting, and trend signals across e-commerce retailers. The stylesage.co domain now redirects to Centric Software, which acquired the product and folded it into its Centric Market Intelligence platform for fashion, footwear, home, and beauty brands. As of this enrichment pass no standalone public developer API, documentation, SDK, or well-known surface is published for StyleSage.

providers.name: Sweetgreen
providers.description: Sweetgreen is a fast-casual restaurant company (NYSE: SG) building healthy, plant-forward food through a network of company-owned locations and its digital ordering platform. It reaches customers primarily via its consumer website and mobile app for pickup, delivery, and its Sweetgreen Rewards loyalty program, and operates automated "Infinite Kitchen" locations. As of this enrichment pass, Sweetgreen publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specifications; this profile captures its public web presence and probed domain-security posture only. Backed by D1 Capital and True Ventures.

providers.name: ThirdLove
providers.description: ThirdLove is a San Francisco-based direct-to-consumer women's intimate apparel brand best known for its online Fit Finder quiz and half-cup bra sizing, selling bras, underwear, and loungewear direct to consumers through its e-commerce site. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of a16z and Felicis. An enrichment pass on 2026-07-21 found no public developer or API surface — no developer subdomain, no documented API, no /.well-known/ discovery documents, and no security.txt or trust-center program. Only a domain-security probe of thirdlove.com yielded real data (TLS 1.3, HSTS, SPF, DMARC).

providers.name: Toasty
providers.description: Toasty (toasty.family, published by Wenose) is a French consumer mobile application for responsible, sustainable, and ethical shopping. The app curates committed brands and makes conscious consumption engaging through a gamified experience of daily private sales, quizzes, challenges, gifts, and rewards. It reports a 4.9-star rating across the app stores and more than 400,000 downloads. Toasty is a business-to-consumer mobile product with no public developer program, API, or documentation surface at this time; it was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead. This profile captures its public identity and a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Tops Friendly Markets
providers.description: Tops Friendly Markets is a regional supermarket chain headquartered in Amherst, New York operating 152 grocery stores and 58 gas station and convenience stores across upstate New York, northern Pennsylvania, and Vermont. In November 2021 Tops Holding II merged with Price Chopper / Market 32 to form Northeast Grocery Inc, a roughly 300-store regional alliance under common ownership. The Tops consumer brand continues to operate an e-commerce platform with online grocery pickup and DoorDash delivery, the BonusPlus loyalty card program with digital coupons and gas rewards, the MoolahVille cash back rewards program, in-store pharmacies, gift cards, and iOS and Android mobile apps. Vendor and supplier engagement is handled through Northeast Shared Services. No public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, webhook, EDI portal, status page, RSS feed, or changelog is published for the Tops brand.

providers.name: Wineaccess
providers.description: Wine Access is an online wine retailer that curates limited-production and hard-to-find wines from around the world, sourced and vetted by its team of sommeliers and wine experts. Beyond direct e-commerce, the company operates a portfolio of subscription wine clubs (Discovery, Connoisseurs, Champagne, Collector's, Decanter, and Sunset clubs), a wine podcast and editorial content platform at discover.wineaccess.com, corporate and personal gifting, gift cards, and climate-controlled shipping. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners. As of this profile, Wine Access publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; it is a consumer e-commerce brand rather than an API provider.

providers.name: Xingsheng Selected
providers.description: Xingsheng Selected (兴盛优选, Hunan Xingsheng Youxuan E-Commerce Co., Ltd.) is a Changsha, Hunan-based Chinese community group-buying platform, grown out of the Furong Xingsheng convenience-store chain and built on a "pre-sale plus self-pickup" model: consumers order groceries and daily necessities online by 23:00 and collect them the next morning from a neighborhood convenience store acting as a pickup point, supplied through the company's own central-warehouse, grid-station and store logistics network. It has raised roughly USD 5.4B from investors including Tencent, KKR, Primavera Capital, Temasek and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan, and has contracted out of loss-making provinces since 2022. Xingsheng Selected operates no developer program: probing found no portal, documentation, OpenAPI, webhook or .well-known document on any host it controls, and its supplier system is login-walled.

providers.name: Zepto
providers.description: Zepto (Zepto Marketplace Private Limited) is an Indian quick-commerce grocery delivery company founded in 2021 that delivers groceries, fresh fruits and vegetables, meat, pet care, beauty and household products "in minutes" from a network of dark stores across major Indian cities. It operates a consumer-facing mobile app and website (zepto.com, formerly zeptonow.com) and publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; its partner-facing surfaces are limited to merchant onboarding (Sell on Zepto / brands.zepto.co.in), delivery-partner and franchise programs. Backed by General Catalyst, Lightspeed Venture Partners and Y Combinator.

providers.name: bigbasket
providers.description: bigbasket is India's largest online grocery and daily-essentials retailer, now part of the Tata Group, delivering fresh produce, packaged foods, household, and personal-care products across Indian cities via web and mobile apps (bigbasket, bbnow, and bbdaily subscription delivery). Surfaced as a Bessemer Venture Partners portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. bigbasket operates as a consumer app rather than an API platform: it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or client SDKs. Its only first-party public developer surface is the github.com/BigBasket organization and the open-source @bb-tech react-admin UI component libraries on npm.

providers.name: Lululemon Athletica
providers.description: Lululemon Athletica is a designer, distributor, and retailer of technical athletic apparel, footwear, and accessories for women, men, and girls. Lululemon does not currently publish a public developer portal or open APIs; digital integrations are handled through partner relationships and internal ecommerce, retail, and supply-chain platforms.

providers.name: Onda
providers.description: Onda is a ready-to-drink spirits brand that makes canned sparkling tequila — blanco tequila from a woman-owned distillery in Jalisco, Mexico, blended with sparkling water and real fruit juice and sold in 12 oz cans at 5% ABV, 100 calories, zero sugar and naturally gluten free, in lime, blood orange, watermelon and grapefruit. The company was founded in 2019 and launched publicly in July 2020 by Noah Gray (CEO), Max Dworin (COO), Kelli Adams (CCO) and actor-producer Shay Mitchell (Chief Brand Officer). It raised a $5M Series A in 2021 and a $12.5M growth round in 2022 from existing investors including Aria Growth Partners and 25madison, and sells through national grocery, liquor retail and third-party beverage e-commerce alongside its own direct-to-consumer store. NO PUBLIC API SURFACE: Onda is a consumer packaged goods company, not a software vendor — there is no developer program, no API documentation, no SDK and no machine-readable contract of any kind. Its only owned web property, drinkonda.com, is a Shopify storefront that on 2026-08-26 returned HTTP 404 "This store is unavailable" on every path probed, with a robots.txt that disallows all crawling and a Shopify-generated /llms.txt that states agent interaction is not possible; the last archived working capture of the storefront is 2026-02-18. Onda appears in the API Evangelist network because it trades on the private secondary market (EquityZen, Nasdaq Private Market), not because it publishes an API.

providers.name: Publix Super Markets
providers.description: Publix Super Markets is one of the largest employee-owned supermarket chains in the United States, headquartered in Lakeland, Florida. It operates grocery stores, pharmacies, delivery, catering, and online ordering services across the southeastern United States. Publix is a Fortune 500 company. No public developer APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

providers.name: Rent the Runway
providers.description: Rent the Runway is a New York-based fashion technology company operating a subscription and one-time rental service for designer apparel and accessories, delivered direct-to-consumer through its website and mobile apps. Surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass the company publishes no first-party public developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, or developer portal; its GitHub organization holds only internal Java/RabbitMQ tooling and forks, and third-party access is limited to an affiliate program run through external commerce networks.

providers.name: Wawa
providers.description: Wawa is a privately held, family-owned convenience store and fuel retail chain headquartered in Pennsylvania. Founded in 1803 as a dairy farm and operating convenience stores since 1964, Wawa runs approximately 1,100 stores across Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Delaware, Maryland, Virginia, Florida, North Carolina, Indiana, and Alabama. The company is a regional fresh-food, beverage, and fuel brand with a strong loyalty program (Wawa Rewards) and a mobile ordering app. Wawa operates an internal API management platform (built with MuleSoft) used to connect to third-party services such as Uber Eats, Grubhub, and DoorDash for delivery, but does not publish a public developer portal or expose public APIs.

providers.name: Williams-Sonoma
providers.description: Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is a Fortune 500 American publicly traded retail company specializing in kitchenware and home furnishings. It is one of the largest e-commerce retailers in the United States. The company operates multiple brands including Williams Sonoma, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, PBteen, West Elm, Rejuvenation, Mark and Graham, and Green Row. Williams-Sonoma does not offer a public developer API. The company uses internal APIs and third-party platforms for e-commerce, registry services, and supply chain management.

providers.name: Crmbônus
providers.description: Crmbônus is a Brazilian SaaS company offering a suite of tools for retail businesses to attract, convert, and retain customers through loyalty programs, cashback, conversational commerce, and retail media solutions. Their platform integrates with WhatsApp, e‑commerce, and ERP systems, providing analytics, campaigns, and member management to boost sales and customer engagement across multiple channels.

providers.name: Operand
providers.description: Operand is an AI-enabled pricing and commercial strategy platform for consumer retail, founded in 2024 and backed by Felicis, Y Combinator, SV Angel, and Soma Capital. It applies proprietary AI systems — an autonomous "agent swarm" — to set pricing and promotion strategy for mid-market and enterprise brands and retailers managing thousands of SKUs, volatile demand, and thin margins, running simulations to benchmark margin, revenue, and inventory-turn objectives before automating price changes. Operand is delivered as a managed platform with expert support and request-a-quote pricing rather than a public developer API; it currently publishes no OpenAPI, developer portal, or self-serve SDKs. An earlier Operand product at operand.ai offered an embeddings / semantic-search API with Python, Go, and TypeScript SDKs, now discontinued.

providers.name: 1K Kirana Bazaar
providers.description: 1K Kirana Bazaar (legal entity Odicea Distribution Technologies Private Limited, also trading as 1K Networks) is a Gurugram, Haryana based Indian kirana-tech company founded in 2018 by Kumar Sangeetesh, Sachin Sharma and Abhishek Halder. It franchised neighbourhood grocery stores across Delhi NCR, Haryana, Rajasthan and Uttar Pradesh and gave them an operating stack — a point-of-sale and inventory system, direct FMCG sourcing through its own B2B distribution network, store-level analytics, payments, the Farm Gold private label, the OneClub loyalty programme, and a consumer ordering app that turned the store into a local fulfilment point. At its peak the company reported around 1,000 partner stores, more than a million customers and coverage of 25-plus districts, and it raised roughly $36-44 million across seed, Series A ($7M, 2021), Series B ($25M, 2022) and a 2023 bridge round from Info Edge Ventures, Falcon Edge Capital, Alpha Wave Global and Quiet Capital. Operations all but stopped in May 2024 amid a funding shortfall and reported bankruptcy and distress-sale discussions, after headcount fell from over 1,000 to roughly 30. The company never operated a public developer program: there is no developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI or other machine-readable specification, SDK, package or webhook catalogue on any domain it controls, and the API hosts it once ran internally (api., api-gateway., vendor-api., wms-*-api., go-api-staging.1knetworks.com) are all NXDOMAIN today. The company's own surviving web presence is the single-page marketing site at www.1knetworks.in, whose WHOIS registrant organization is Odicea Distribution Technologies Private Limited.

providers.name: Aswemake
providers.description: Aswemake Inc. operates a digital platform for food and beverage retail, unifying offline grocery information into an online service that reduces costs for consumers and enhances competitiveness for merchants. The company offers a marketplace where customers can purchase food items at low prices, leveraging technology to streamline logistics and provide a seamless shopping experience across South Korea.

providers.name: Axfood
providers.description: Axfood is a Swedish food retail and wholesale company focused on providing affordable, good, and sustainable food. It operates various grocery chains and brands across Sweden, emphasizing quality of life improvements, local sourcing, and environmental responsibility. The company’s mission is to develop and operate successful concepts in the Swedish food market, delivering value to customers and partners.

providers.name: Brightloom
providers.description: Brightloom is a San Francisco customer data and customer intelligence platform for restaurant and retail brands. It began as Eatsa, the automated quinoa-bowl restaurant chain, and rebranded to Brightloom in 2019 when Starbucks licensed select components of its Digital Flywheel customer engagement software to the company, took an equity stake and a board seat alongside a $30M round. The product unifies point-of-sale, loyalty, ecommerce and marketing data into a single customer view, reports on data health, runs AI-driven hyper-segmentation and anomaly detection over that data, and recommends the next campaign and audience a brand should target. Brightloom was sold as an end-user SaaS with prebuilt connectors to common POS, loyalty and marketing platforms rather than as a developer platform, and it published no public API reference, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification. The company now appears defunct: the last dated item on its own press page is December 2022, the entire operating estate it once held TLS certificates for is gone from DNS — api.brightloom.com, api-prd/api-dev, the cgp.brightloom.com application, its auth0-cgp Auth0 tenant, and the status, support and knowledgebase hosts all NXDOMAIN — brightloom.com publishes no MX record, and only the frozen marketing site remains, with its /about/ page defaced by injected search-spam.

providers.name: Brodo
providers.description: Brodo (PT Brodo Ganesha Indonesia) is an Indonesian direct-to-consumer footwear and menswear brand founded in Bandung, selling shoes, apparel, and accessories through its official webstore at bro.do. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. Brodo runs a consumer e-commerce storefront on a third-party commerce platform (Plugo) with local Indonesian payment rails (NicePay); it publishes no first-party developer API, OpenAPI, developer portal, SDK, or public integration surface at this time, so there are no API artifacts to enrich beyond this company profile.

providers.name: Chico's FAS
providers.description: Chico's FAS, Inc. is an American women's specialty retailer headquartered in Fort Myers, Florida, operating and franchising stores and websites under the Chico's, White House Black Market, and Soma brands. The company is a leading omni-channel specialty retailer of private branded sophisticated, casual-to-dressy clothing, intimates, sleepwear, and related accessories, with more than 1,400 retail and outlet stores in the United States and a substantial e-commerce footprint. Chico's FAS is part of the KnitWell Group portfolio. Chico's FAS does not currently publish a public consumer-facing developer API; partner integrations are coordinated through corporate channels and the loyalty/credit card partnership with Synchrony and Mastercard.

providers.name: Acne Studios
providers.description: Acne Studios is a Stockholm-based fashion house founded in 1996 as part of the creative collective ACNE (Ambition to Create Novel Expressions). The company designs and sells ready-to-wear womenswear and menswear, footwear, leather goods, denim, and accessories through its global network of retail stores and its official e-commerce site at acnestudios.com. Surfaced as a portfolio company of idg-capital and added to the API Evangelist network. Acne Studios publishes no public developer API program or developer portal; this profile captures its public web identity and live domain-security posture. Sector: consumer / fashion retail.

providers.name: Anycart
providers.description: Anycart is a consumer grocery delivery and store-pickup platform that lets shoppers enter a zip code, choose a favorite local grocery store, and shop for anything they need with no price markups and no service fees. The service spans multiple U.S. retailers and focuses on transparent pricing for everyday grocery ordering, delivery, and pickup. Anycart was surfaced as a portfolio company of Menlo Ventures and Techstars and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. It operates a consumer web and mobile storefront (anycart.com) and does not publish a public developer program, OpenAPI definition, or API documentation at this time.

providers.name: asgoodasnew
providers.description: asgoodasnew is a German e-commerce retailer of refurbished and pre-owned consumer electronics, including smartphones, tablets, laptops, cameras, and related accessories, sold with warranty through its online store at asgoodasnew.de (asgoodasnew.com redirects there). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Point Nine and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead. Probing the public surface found no developer portal, API documentation, or API host — this is a consumer-facing storefront with no public API program at this time. The profile is retained as a portfolio lead; only mechanical domain-security signals for the web host could be captured.

providers.name: Belle International
providers.description: Belle International Holdings (百丽国际) is one of China's largest women's footwear and fashion retailers, designing, manufacturing, and distributing shoe brands such as Belle, Teenmix, Tata, and Staccato alongside a sportswear-distribution business, across thousands of directly operated retail outlets and a growing e-commerce presence. Formerly listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, the group was taken private in 2017 by a consortium led by Hillhouse Capital and CDH Investments in one of the largest Hong Kong take-private deals. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Hillhouse; enrichment found no public developer portal, API program, or machine-readable API surface for this consumer-retail company. This remains an identity and domain-security profile rather than an integratable API provider.

providers.name: BetaStore
providers.description: BetaStore (legal entity SimpleMarket Inc., trading as BetaStore.co) is a B2B retail marketplace founded in 2020 by Steve Dakayi-Kamga and Leo-Armel Tchoudjang that serves informal neighborhood retailers in West and Central Africa, operating across Nigeria, Senegal and Ivory Coast from offices in Lagos and a Wilmington, Delaware registration. The platform lets small shopkeepers restock fast-moving consumer goods directly from manufacturers and distributors at wholesale prices, ordering through SMS, chat, WhatsApp and a mobile app, with logistics partners delivering to the store within 24 hours, and it layers embedded working-capital financing on top of observed retailer sales. BetaStore raised a 2.5 million dollar pre-Series A in May 2022 led by 500 Global with VestedWorld and Loyal VC. As of the July 2026 enrichment pass BetaStore publishes no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDK or machine-readable artifact of any kind, and its betastore.co domain serves no content -- both the apex and www hosts answer every path with a blanket Cloudflare 301 to unrelated third-party domains, and no api/app/docs subdomain resolves.

providers.name: Big Heart Pet Brands
providers.description: Big Heart Pet Brands was a producer and marketer of branded pet food and snacks with brands including Meow Mix, Milk-Bone, Kibbles 'n Bits, 9Lives, Natural Balance, Pup-Peroni, Gravy Train, Nature's Recipe, Canine Carry Outs, and Milo's Kitchen. Big Heart Pet Brands was acquired by The J.M. Smucker Company in 2015 and no longer operates as an independent entity. All brands are now managed under J.M. Smucker's Pet Foods division.

providers.name: Blue Bottle Coffee *
providers.description: Blue Bottle Coffee is a specialty coffee roaster and retailer founded in 2002 in Oakland, California by James Freeman, known for freshly roasted single-origin beans, seasonal blends, cafes, and a direct-to-consumer subscription service that ships coffee within 48 hours of roasting. A majority stake was acquired by Nestle in 2017. The company operates cafes across the United States and Asia and sells whole-bean coffee, brewing equipment, and gift subscriptions through its e-commerce site. Surfaced as a portfolio company of gv, kindred-ventures and true-ventures; no public developer API program has been found. Sector: consumer.

providers.name: Bluestone
providers.description: BlueStone is one of India's largest online retailers of fine jewellery, founded in 2011 by Gaurav Singh Kushwaha and headquartered in Bangalore. It runs an omnichannel model spanning its e-commerce storefront and 125+ physical stores across India, offering 7,000+ BIS-hallmarked and certified designs in gold, diamond, gemstone, and platinum, plus services such as lifetime exchange, buyback, 30-day returns, and personal video consultations. The company is backed by Accel. BlueStone publishes no public developer portal or API; this profile captures the company's identity and a probed domain-security posture for the network.

providers.name: BrandCT
providers.description: BrandCT (品牌CT) is an offline-retail market-monitoring service operated by Mashangying (马上赢市场调查 / yikuaigao), a Chinese retail-data company. It has built a national offline-retail monitoring network based on POS data from a panel of sample stores, and delivers brand owners a "BrandCT" service that scans more than 10 million products across offline retail formats to quantify market share, distribution (铺市率), and product sell-through. The platform supports quantitative analysis of product innovation, channel competition, and category trends to speed up and sharpen client decision-making. The product is delivered through a login-gated web dashboard (WeChat, phone, and email verification sign-in); no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or /.well-known discovery surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: BuyWithMe (Gilt Groupe)
providers.description: BuyWithMe (Gilt Groupe) is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: commerce. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Bzaar
providers.description: Bzaar is a cross-border business-to-business wholesale marketplace founded in 2020-2021 by Nishant Verman (previously head of corporate development at Flipkart) and Prasanth Nair (previously engineering and product at Amazon, Flipkart, and Lazada), headquartered in Palo Alto / San Francisco, California with operations in India. The platform connected small and medium retailers in the United States and other markets with curated suppliers and manufacturers in India and Southeast Asia, listing thousands of products across home, lifestyle, accessories, apparel, jewelry, cookware, and bakeware verticals, and layering sourcing services such as vendor management, quality control, consolidated logistics, and cross-border payments on top of the catalog. Bzaar raised a $4 million seed round led by Canaan Partners with participation from Binny Bansal, Sameer Nigam, Rahul Chari, Lee Fixel, and Ashish Gupta. As of this enrichment pass Bzaar publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface, and its bzaar.com domain resolves to a registrar parking page rather than a live product site.

providers.name: Caleres
providers.description: Caleres is an American footwear company headquartered in Clayton, Missouri, established in 1878 (rebranded from Brown Shoe Company in 2015). It designs, develops, sources, manufactures, and distributes footwear through its Famous Footwear retail segment (approximately 900 U.S. locations) and Brand Portfolio segment which includes Sam Edelman, Stuart Weitzman, Allen Edmonds, Naturalizer, Vionic, LifeStride, Dr. Scholl's, Rykä, Franco Sarto, and Blowfish Malibu. Caleres does not currently publish a public developer API program; integrations are typically handled through B2B EDI and partner channels.

providers.name: Cazoo
providers.description: Cazoo was a UK online used-car retailer founded in 2018 by Alex Chesterman, offering a direct-to-consumer platform to buy, sell, and finance used cars fully online with home delivery. The company listed on the New York Stock Exchange via a SPAC merger in 2021 before restructuring and entering administration in 2024; its consumer marketplace brand was subsequently sold. Cazoo was surfaced as a portfolio company of D1 Capital, General Catalyst, and Sapphire Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. No public developer portal or API surface was found during enrichment: the site is behind bot protection (HTTP 429) and no /.well-known/ discovery documents are published. Sector: ecommerce / automotive retail.

providers.name: chatail
providers.description: Chatail is a Shanghai-based SaaS company (founded 2016) that provides private-domain livestream and video sales software for high-end and luxury retail brands across fashion, jewelry, beauty, automotive, and home-goods verticals, pairing intelligent customer acquisition with conversion tooling ("智能获客与高效转化双轮驱动"). The product is delivered as a hosted web application at chatail.com; no public developer API, documentation portal, or OpenAPI surface is published at this time (api.chatail.com serves a default nginx placeholder). Chatail raised a Series B round led by Qiming Venture Partners and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a Qiming portfolio company.

providers.name: Chi Forest
providers.description: Chi Forest (marketed as CHI FOREST) is the US-facing consumer beverage brand of the Chinese drinks company Genki Forest (元气森林), backed by Hongshan (Sequoia China) and IDG Capital. The company produces zero-sugar, zero-calorie, zero-caffeine sparkling refreshers with Asian-inspired, fruit-forward flavors such as guava and lychee, distributed through retailers including Costco, Amazon, and H Mart. It is a direct-to-consumer and retail beverage brand with a marketing/e-commerce web presence and no public developer platform, API, or documentation surface at this time. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a consumer-sector company record.

providers.name: Cider
providers.description: Cider is a global direct-to-consumer digital-first fashion brand geared toward Gen Z shoppers, founded in 2020 and operating primarily at shopcider.com and through its mobile apps. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), DST Global, and Greenoaks Capital, Cider reached unicorn valuation as a fast-fashion challenger to SHEIN, using a data- and community-driven, on-demand manufacturing model to offer trend-forward women's clothing and accessories worldwide. Cider is a consumer retailer; it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation. This profile was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Core-Mark Holding
providers.description: Core-Mark Holding Company, a subsidiary of Performance Food Group, is one of the largest broad-line, full-service marketers and distributors of packaged consumer products to the convenience retail industry in North America. The company serves more than 41,000 retail locations across the United States and Canada, supplying tobacco, candy, snacks, beverages, foodservice, and other fast-moving consumer goods. Core-Mark provides retailer technology platforms including Core-Source Portal, Retailer Analytics, Core-Mark Ordering, and Core-Mark Intellisite.
